entries.title: Psalms 114:2
segments:
His sanctuary; the place where God dwelt and was worshipped. 
 
  His dominion; the people over whom he ruled in a special sense.

entries.title: Psalms 114:3
segments:
Fled; became dry. 
 
All nature is under the control of Jehovah, and is obedient to his will.

entries.title: Psalms 114:7
segments: Creation feels the presence of Jehovah, and is dependent on him for its existence and condition.

entries.title: Psalms 114:8
segments:
Turned the rock into a standing water; as was the case in the wilderness. 
 
The miraculous provision which God made for the wants of Israel in the wilderness, is an emblem of the inexhaustible supplies of grace which he has in store for all who put their trust in him.
